# Al Sadat Builders

> Premier Construction & Renovation Company in Islamabad, Rawalpindi & Bani Gala, Pakistan. Led by CEO Syed Mujtaba Shah with 30+ years of construction experience.

## Overview

Al Sadat Builders is an established Pakistani construction contractor providing residential house construction, seismic-resistant grey structures, home remodeling, marble & tile fixing, boundary walls, plaster & waterproofing, and finishing works across the Islamabad Capital Territory, Rawalpindi, and Bani Gala. Founded and supervised on-site by Syed Mujtaba Shah, the company specializes in 5 Marla, 7 Marla, 8 Marla, 10 Marla, and 1 Kanal+ villas as well as commercial plazas.

## Core Services

1. **Turnkey House Construction (Islamabad & Rawalpindi)**
   - Complete A-to-Z residential builds from groundbreaking to key handover
   - Architectural and structural engineering drawings
   - Custom floor plans for 3 Marla, 5 Marla, 10 Marla, 1 Kanal and 2 Kanal plots
   - High-end finishing: porcelain tiling, imported sanitary, Ash wood doors, false ceilings, and weather-shield paint

2. **Grey Structure Construction**
   - Certified Grade 60 rebar (Mughal, Amreli, Model Steel)
   - Brand-new factory-fresh cement (Fauji, Bestway OPC)
   - Double-screened clean Margalla crushed aggregate
   - Machine excavation, anti-termite chemical barrier, and DPC damp-proofing
   - Seismic RCC frame: footings, plinth beams, columns, roof slabs, and 14-day water curing
   - Awwal burnt red clay brick masonry and boundary wall construction
   - Concealed electrical conduits and PPRC/PVC plumbing rough-ins
   - Underground and overhead reinforced water tanks

3. **House Renovation & Remodeling**
   - Modern kitchen remodeling (open-concept island layouts, UV/acrylic cabinets)
   - Luxury bathroom renovation (vanity upgrades, glass shower enclosures, concealed mixers)
   - Porcelain floor tiling and marble stairs/countertop replacement
   - Internal smooth plastering and external rockwall/graphy plaster
   - Chemical basement tanking and bitumen roof waterproofing for leakage elimination
   - Second-storey room additions and structural crack repair

4. **Marble & Tile Fixing (Islamabad & Bani Gala)**
   - Premium Italian and Pakistani marble installation for floors, stairs, and countertops
   - Large-format porcelain tile precision cutting and laying
   - Bathroom and kitchen tile renovation and replacement
   - Anti-slip outdoor tile fixing

5. **Boundary Wall Construction & Retaining Walls**
   - Reinforced brick and block boundary walls for residential plots
   - Hillside retaining walls for Bani Gala and sloped terrain
   - Gabion basket retaining structures
   - Site leveling and compound gate piers

6. **Plaster Work & Waterproofing**
   - Internal smooth cement and gypsum plaster finishing
   - External textured (rock/graphy) plaster coatings
   - Chemical injection basement tanking
   - Torch-on and liquid-applied roof waterproofing systems
   - Bathroom waterproofing membrane installation

7. **Demolition & Boundary Walls**
   - Safe, controlled partial or complete demolition of old buildings
   - Debris disposal and site ground leveling
   - Reinforced brick or concrete block boundary walls

8. **Overseas Pakistani Construction Management**
   - Dedicated remote management for expatriate Pakistanis in UK, USA, Canada, Saudi Arabia, and UAE
   - Weekly HD video progress inspections on WhatsApp
   - Milestone-linked payments through formal bank accounts
   - Full material receipt transparency and digital ledger reporting

## Pricing Philosophy & Estimates

Al Sadat Builders calculates all costs using an Itemized Bill of Quantities (BOQ) with guaranteed material brands rather than arbitrary square-foot quotes. As of 2026:
- **Grey Structure:** Generally PKR 2,400 – 3,200 / sq. ft. depending on steel rates, soil conditions, and basements.
- **Turnkey Finishing:** Generally PKR 4,800 – 7,500+ / sq. ft. depending on local vs. imported sanitary, marble, and woodwork specifications.
- **Free Feasibility:** Prospective clients receive a free 30-minute on-site engineering survey and customized BOQ estimate.
